description: This file contains helper functions for testing the behavior of 'git read-tree' command, verifying its success or failure under different options and conditions, ensuring that dry-run modes do not alter the index or working tree.

methods.name: read_tree_must_succeed
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree' succeeds without altering the index or working directory when run with given arguments.

methods.name: read_tree_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree' fails with given arguments, and that the index remains unchanged.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree' with the -u option succeeds and does not modify the index or working directory.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree' with the -u option fails and leaves the index and working directory unchanged.
